facts.fact: Adwave's resource page lists a test campaign budget for creators of $50-200 to learn how TV works for a brand.
facts.quote: **Test campaign:** $50-200 to learn how TV works for your brand

facts.fact: Adwave's resource page lists a launch campaign budget of $500-1,000 for course launches or major announcements.
facts.quote: **Launch campaign:** $500-1,000 for course launches or major announcements

facts.fact: Adwave's resource page lists an ongoing presence budget of $300-500 per month for consistent brand building.
Adwave states that creators can start TV advertising at $50 on its platform.
facts.quote: [Platforms like Adwave](https://adwave.com/) let creators start at $50, creating professional ads from existing content.

facts.fact: Adwave's resource page says creators no longer need $50,000 to get on television.
facts.quote: The days of needing $50,000 to get on television are over.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide suggests an influencer starting TV advertising budget of $500 to $1,000 to test whether TV drives measurable follower growth.
facts.quote: Start with $500 to $1,000 to test whether TV drives measurable follower growth or engagement for your brand.
